test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

It had been decided that the final exam would not be graded on a curve this semester.

options.text: They had decided that the final exam would not be graded on a curve this semester.
The final exam would not be graded on a curve this semester, it had been decided.
They have decided that the final exam would not be graded on a curve this semester.
The final exam was decided not to be graded on a curve this semester.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• To convert from passive voice to active voice, identify the subject performing the action in the sentence.
 
• In the given passive sentence, the subject performing the action is implied as "they."
 
• Rearrange the sentence so that the subject ("they") comes first, followed by the verb ("had decided"), and then the object ("the final exam would not be graded on a curve this semester").
 
• Ensure the verb tense remains consistent (past perfect).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"They had decided that the final exam would not be graded on a curve this semester."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The final exam would not be graded on a curve this semester, it had been decided." – This retains the passive voice structure and is not in active voice.
 
• **Option 3:** "They have decided that the final exam would not be graded on a curve this semester." – Incorrect tense (present perfect instead of past perfect).
 
• **Option 4:** "The final exam was decided not to be graded on a curve this semester." – Incorrect phrasing and passive voice structure.
